user_story: As a user, I want to log in to my account using my email and password so that I can access my profile and manage my account settings.
acceptance_criteria: The login form should contain an input field with name 'email' and placeholder 'Email Address'.
The login form should contain an input field with name 'password' and placeholder 'Password'.
There should be a button with text 'Login' to submit the login form.
cypress_script: describe('Login Functionality', () => { it('should successfully log in with valid credentials', () => { cy.visit('https://automationexercise.com/login'); cy.get('input[name=email]').type('test@example.com'); cy.get('input[name=password]').type('password123'); cy.get('button.btn.btn-default').contains('Login').click(); cy.url().should('not.include', '/login'); }); it('should show an error with invalid credentials', () => { cy.visit('https://automationexercise.com/login'); cy.get('input[name=email]').type('invalid@example.com'); cy.get('input[name=password]').type('wrongpassword'); cy.get('button.btn.btn-default').contains('Login').click(); cy.get('h2').should('contain', 'Login to your account'); }); });
playwright_script: import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'; test('Login Functionality', async ({ page }) => { await page.goto('https://automationexercise.com/login'); await page.fill('input[name=email]', 'test@example.com'); await page.fill('input[name=password]', 'password123'); await page.click('button.btn.btn-default:has-text("Login")'); await expect(page).not.toHaveURL(/login/); }); test('Invalid Login Attempt', async ({ page }) => { await page.goto('https://automationexercise.com/login'); await page.fill('input[name=email]', 'invalid@example.com'); await page.fill('input[name=password]', 'wrongpassword'); await page.click('button.btn.btn-default:has-text("Login")'); await expect(page.locator('h2')).toContainText('Login to your account'); }); }
